subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should fresh, currently authorized MCP App views be allowed to request one operator-confirmed plain-text chat turn under the proposed visibility, focus, slash-command, length, and rate-limit gates?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but accepting untrusted embedded app content as a source of operator-confirmed chat text is an intentional security and product boundary decision that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the gated bridge
options.body: Accept the current text-only, exact-consent design while keeping reconstructed views read-only and rich content unsupported.

options.title: Keep MCP Apps read-only
options.body: Decline app-initiated chat messages for now and land only the live host-context updates in a narrower change.

recommendation.title: Approve the gated bridge
recommendation.body: Accept the current text-only, exact-consent design while keeping reconstructed views read-only and rich content unsupported.
